claims.text: The unmodified lightweight high-entropy-alloy baseline has a density below 6 g/cm^3.
The intervention adds 0.1-0.5 wt% elemental boron to the alloy.
The alloy is processed by mechanical alloying followed by spark plasma sintering.
Boron is introduced as elemental boron powder.
Adding boron forms a boron-rich grain-boundary phase.
The boron-rich grain-boundary phase enhances grain-boundary cohesion.
The boron-rich grain-boundary phase reduces oxidation susceptibility.
The boron-rich grain-boundary phase reduces corrosion susceptibility.
Boron atoms segregate to grain boundaries.
Segregated boron forms a thin, stable boride phase at grain boundaries.
The grain-boundary boride phase inhibits grain-boundary sliding.
Boron addition increases room-temperature yield strength relative to the unmodified alloy.
Boron addition increases room-temperature ultimate tensile strength relative to the unmodified alloy.
Boron addition increases room-temperature elongation relative to the unmodified alloy.
Boron addition improves saltwater corrosion resistance relative to the unmodified alloy.
Boron addition improves high-temperature oxidation resistance in air relative to the unmodified alloy.
The boron-modified alloy retains a density below 6 g/cm^3.
The proposed hypothesis is restricted to boron additions no greater than 0.5 wt%.
The optimal boron concentration and the precise property-enhancement mechanism are uncertain.
The hypothesis is falsified if the modified alloy fails to improve at least two measured properties by more than 10% relative to the control.

contradictions.description: The prediction asserts improvement in all five listed performance categories, but the falsification rule allows the hypothesis to survive when only two improve by more than 10%, even if the other predicted properties do not improve or deteriorate.

The baseline is described as having the same composition as the modified alloy, although adding boron necessarily changes total composition. It should instead be defined as having the same base composition except for boron.
